description: Discomfort is a gift , self mastery is a skill #selfmastery #selfdiscovery #discomfort
transcript: This comfort does not bother me. I do not force my life. I do not pressure the direction to go one way over the other. One know for me equates to 40 yeses. I don't always have the perfect answers, but I do know that I ask great questions and the more that I ask of myself. The more I'm able to dissect, deconstruct and analyze my life for what it is and my brain for what it is. And mastering myself, mastering my thought process has allowed me the capacity to land safely wherever it is. I do not fear my destination. I do not fear the steps that it takes to get there. This life was created for me.
